responsibility: Implements the small DJGPP-specific backend hooks that customize x86 assembly emission for the DOS/COFF environment. In particular it owns the named-section printer used by the i386 DJGPP target, including the special 1-byte alignment marker for LTO sections, and the start/end hooks that temporarily suppress debug info emission around LTO output to work around early-LTO debug limitations in this object format.
same_name_distinction: Unlike djgpp.h, which defines the DJGPP target macros and hooks, and djgpp.opt, which only declares the DJGPP-specific driver option, this source file is the implementation unit for the small DJGPP backend hooks themselves: the named-section emitter and the LTO start/end debug-info workaround for the DOS/COFF target.
